# Temple Scroll Column 36 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 36 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**36:1** And you shall make places to the east of the temple city, separated from it — for those with skin diseases.

**36:2** And they shall dwell there alone and shall not enter the temple city.

**36:3** And you shall make places to the north of the temple city — for all who have discharges: the man with a discharge, and the man with an emission of seed.

**36:4** And they shall dwell there until the day of their purification; and they shall not enter the temple city in their uncleanness.

**36:5** And you shall make a place to the west of the temple city — for women in the days of their impurity.

**36:6** And they shall not enter My temple city, and they shall not defile My temple city in which I dwell.

**36:7** For I the LORD dwell in the midst of the sons of Israel forever and always.

**36:8** And every man who purifies himself from a skin disease — he shall bring the offering of his purification before he enters the temple city.

**36:9** And the priest shall examine him outside the city; and if the disease has departed from him, then the priest shall pronounce him clean.

**36:10** And on the eighth day he shall bring his guilt offering and his sin offering and his burnt offering according to the instruction.

**36:11** And the man with a discharge — when his discharge ceases, he shall count seven days for his purification.

**36:12** And on the eighth day he shall wash his garments and bathe his body in living water; and he shall be clean.

**36:13** And after that he may enter the temple city; and he shall bring his offering to the LORD — two turtledoves or two young pigeons: one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.

**36:14** And the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge; and he shall be clean.

**36:15** And the sons of Israel shall keep themselves separate from all uncleanness; and they shall not defile the land in which I dwell.

**36:16** For I the LORD dwell in the midst of the sons of Israel; and the land shall be holy.

---

*EMET notes: Column 36 establishes quarantine zones outside the temple city by type of impurity: skin diseases (east), discharges (north), menstruation (west). The purification procedures parallel Leviticus 13-15 but apply them to the idealized temple city. God's indwelling (v. 7, 16) motivates the strict separation.*
